subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should the first public agent-run budget cap tool-calling rounds, individual tool invocations, or both, and what terminal result should exhaustion produce?
rationale: The issue proposes three independent controls while the active candidate implements round counting with optional final summarization; choosing names, scope, defaults, and terminal behavior creates a durable config and harness contract that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Round budget first
options.body: Approve a focused per-agent tool-calling-round budget with one bounded tool-disabled final response, and defer individual-call and elapsed-time limits until separately justified.

options.title: Unified round and call budgets
options.body: Require the initial contract to expose and enforce both tool-calling rounds and individual tool-invocation counts.

options.title: Keep heuristic safeguards
options.body: Decline new count-based configuration and continue relying on pattern loop detection and whole-run/provider timeouts.

recommendation.title: Round budget first
recommendation.body: Approve a focused per-agent tool-calling-round budget with one bounded tool-disabled final response, and defer individual-call and elapsed-time limits until separately justified.

likelyOwner.reason: The configurable loop guard and most subsequent core runtime maintenance trace to this owner, who is also already participating in this issue's routing.
